theorem lg_target {τ : ℂ} (hτ : 0 < τ.im) (n : ℤ) : ‖Complex.exp (↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑n ^ 2 * τ)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im) ^ n.natAbs := by
  intro n
  have h1 : 0 < Real.pi * τ.im := mul_pos (le_refl Real.pi) hτ
  let a := Real.pi * τ.im
  have h2 : 0 < a := h1
  let z := Complex.I * ↑n ^ 2 * τ
  have h3 : ‖Complex.exp z‖ = Real.exp (-a * ↑n.natAbs ^ 2) := by
    erw [Complex.norm_exp]
